name: InterContinental ANA Beppu Resort & Spa
insider_take: A luxury onsen sanctuary where natural hot springs meet contemporary elegance in Japan's legendary hot spring capital.
whats_special: This resort sits in Beppu, home to more hot springs than anywhere else in Japan, with over 2,300 natural onsen producing more hot spring water than any other location on earth. The hotel features authentic Japanese onsen facilities fed by these legendary therapeutic waters, plus you're surrounded by the "Hells of Beppu" - seven spectacular geothermal hot springs including the famous Cobalt Blue Hell and Blood Pond Hell.
pro_tip: Visit the onsen early morning or evening for the most serene experience, and don't miss the traditional sand baths at nearby Takegawara Onsen - you'll be buried in naturally heated volcanic sand for ultimate relaxation.
dont_miss: The hotel's signature onsen experience with Mount Tsurumi views, a day trip to the colorful Jigoku (Hell) hot springs tour, and sampling Beppu's famous hot spring-steamed cuisine where local delicacies are cooked using natural geothermal steam vents.
pros: Authentic onsen hot spring experience with natural thermal waters
Stunning panoramic views of Beppu Bay and surrounding mountains
Full-service spa facilities with traditional Japanese treatments
Premium InterContinental service standards and amenities
cons: Located away from Beppu city center
Higher price point for luxury resort experience
